title: Share “{name}”
introEvent: Invite players outside the organization, or share a link: whoever has it sees the event and can sign up.
introPlace: Invited players see this place, navigate to it and store their items there. Only you can edit it.
linkHint: Anyone with this link sees the event. Signed in, they can sign up and find it among their events.
disableHint: Disabling the link removes access for those who came through it and did not sign up. A new link does the same and gives another address.

errors.tooManyShares: No more than 100 guests per share.
errors.tooManyInvites: You sent 50 invitations today. Try again tomorrow.
errors.forbidden: Only those who manage this can share it.

introMarkerCollection: Invited players see the markers in this collection, on the Star Map and in the NPS, and can navigate to them. Only you can edit them.
